items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: He used Harrison Bones on trombone... I thought him and Harrison Bond was great.

ctx.x: So he'd change up all the time. Yeah. Well who else would he have with him say on trombone? Do you remember any particular guy who stands out in your mind?
Yeah, he used Harrison Bradley, Harrison Bones, Ambrose.
What about in the rhythm? Who would he have?
